relations.name: Preserved Lemon Couscous
relations.rationale: The bright, zesty flavors of preserved lemon complement the smoky heat of harissa, making them a delightful pairing in Middle Eastern-inspired dishes.

relations.name: Mojo Rojo
relations.rationale: Both harissa and mojo rojo share a spicy and smoky profile, making them excellent accompaniments to grilled meats and vegetables.

relations.name: Berbere
relations.rationale: Harissa and berbere both use a variety of spices, including chili, and can be interchangeably used to enhance the depth of flavor in similar dishes.

relations.name: Ras el Hanout
relations.rationale: Ras el Hanout is a versatile spice blend used in North African cuisine, just like harissa, making them complementary in recipes requiring complex flavors.
